description: Phase 2 Day 1 probe: expense-management queries sent through POST /api/v1/chatbot with production settings (guardrails on, grounded answers on, hybrid retriever, mock model, mock backend). Written 2026-11-05 before running. Each reply is graded by hand in review_results.json.
